findings.title: SettingsUpdated + BranchStatusChanged broadcast events are SEMI-ORPHANS — backend dispatches, outbox row created, but ZERO JS Echo subscriber consumes them

evidence.outbox_persistence: domain_events row written with broadcast_as='SettingsUpdated' on channel 'private-branch.{id}'. DispatchDomainEventsJob fires WebSocket broadcast.

frontend_subscribers.broadcastAs_SettingsUpdated_grep: grep -rn 'SettingsUpdated' resources/js/ public/js/ -> 0 matches in frontend listener handlers
frontend_subscribers.comparison_other_events: CatalogChanged, ComposerProfileChanged, CouponChanged, OrderCreated, OrderStatusChanged, ItemAvailabilityChanged ALL have JS subscribers via broadcastAs handlers in KioskAppComponent.vue / KioskWaitingComponent.vue / PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue / useCatalogChangeNotifier.js
frontend_subscribers.the_2_events_missing: ONLY SettingsUpdated + BranchStatusChanged are dispatched without JS handler — the Wave 5G R9 / R10 backend halves landed but their frontend halves were never implemented

findings.impact: POS/Kiosk/Admin SPA do NOT refresh live when owner edits Site/Company/Currency/Tax/OrderSetup or toggles a branch ACTIVE<->INACTIVE. The setting change reaches DB + outbox + WebSocket frame, then is silently discarded. Page reload OR cache invalidation OR token expiry are the only paths to surface the change. The outbox cron retries the broadcast indefinitely without consumer.
findings.blast_radius: Owner-facing daily friction: change currency symbol € -> $, no POS surface updates until tab reload. Change kiosk welcome text -> deployed kiosks still show old text. Toggle branch INACTIVE -> RevokeTokensOnBranchDeactivated logout WORKS (server-side revoke), but no client-side notice fires (silent kick).

findings.title: AdminWebGuardPermissionsSyncSeeder is INERT in current DB — Admin role on web guard doesn't exist, the 82-perm sanctum-to-web mirror is silently skipped

evidence.seeder_logic: Role::query()->where('name','Admin')->where('guard_name','web')->first() returns NULL -> early return with warn 'Admin (web guard) role not found — Admin sync skipped.'
evidence.claude_md_claim: 82 perms × 2 guards post AdminWebGuardPermissionsSyncSeeder — VERIFIED FALSE today: 82 sanctum + 1 web = 83 total, not 164

impact_assessed.case_when_breaks: If any /api/admin/* endpoint resolves the user via web guard session cookie (instead of Sanctum bearer) AND that endpoint runs a permission:foo check, the user gets 403 because the foo permission exists ONLY on sanctum guard. Spatie's Gate compares guard_name strictly.
impact_assessed.case_when_safe: The api.php /api/admin group is authed via 'auth:sanctum' middleware (line 273). $request->user() resolves via Sanctum's PersonalAccessToken, NOT via web session. So all bearer-token traffic uses sanctum guard. Vue SPA admin uses Bearer Authorization header (verified by grep of axios setup) — not session cookies on /api/* — so the web-guard inertness doesn't currently fire as a 403.
impact_assessed.latent_bug: If a future contributor mounts an admin SPA route on session cookies (e.g. via EnsureFrontendRequestsAreStateful), they'll hit silent 403s exactly like the ingredients incident the heal was written for. The CLAUDE.md claim 'post AdminWebGuardPermissionsSyncSeeder = 82 × 2 guards' is misleading.

remediation.option_A_seeder_self_heal: Extend AdminWebGuardPermissionsSyncSeeder to firstOrCreate the Admin (web guard) role itself before mirroring perms
remediation.option_B_remove_seeder: Delete AdminWebGuardPermissionsSyncSeeder + update CLAUDE.md §9 to remove the 82 × 2 claim — the V1 LOCAL admin SPA exclusively uses Sanctum bearer auth, so web-guard perms are unnecessary
remediation.option_C_truth_in_doc: Keep seeder + update CLAUDE.md §9 to state 'AdminWebGuardPermissionsSyncSeeder is a guard against a future drift; in current DB it is INERT because Admin (web) role does not exist. It will activate only if a future seeder creates Admin (web).'
remediation.recommended: Option C (truth in doc) — V1.0.X cloud-prep backlog item UNI-04: decide cleanly whether web guard is needed.
remediation.scope: doc-only (no code change required if web guard auth is not used by SPA), frozen-zone safe
